2 عَجَّجَتِ الرِّيجُ الغُبَارَ , inf. n. تَعْجِيجٌ, The wind raised the dust. (TA.) [See also 1.] ―
-b2- And عَجَّجْتُ البَيْتَ دُخَانًا, (S, O, and so in a copy of the K,) or مِنَ الدُّخَانِ, (so in other copies of the K,) inf. n. as above, (K,) I filled the house, or tent, with smoke. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
